node.statement: Coordinate Ha identity: write Z=(Z_ij), X=(X_j), and Y=(Y_i). For each 1 <= i,j <= n, def-ha-map applied to Z_ij in S_{P,R}, X_j in S_{R,Q}, and Y_i in S_{P,Q} gives (Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij) dot X_j + Y_i^dagger dot (Z_ij dot X_j) = 2*<Y_i,Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j)>*u_Q.
